items.title: Intuitive Initiative Squads & alignment
items.do: Start a combat with Aveline, Durgan, Ogre Chieftain, Orc Warrior, and 4 Goblin Sneaks, then open Initiative. Click enemy checkboxes, click "+ Squad" / "+ Add" (including on the bottom row), test Ungroup All → Auto-Squad Minions, and roll Initiative.
items.expect: Checkboxes have crisp high-contrast borders and checking them puts "Group Selected (N)" in the Enemies header with zero vertical layout shift; "+ Squad" / "+ Add" popovers float cleanly over the window without growing or pushing the bottom footer down; Orc Warrior's sub-line stays on one tidy row without wrapping "GM".
